purpose: Diagnostic of the Prompt-Probe Handover before any pilot: does a correction fitted on a hidden second of the voice prompt (teacher estimate -> real audio) transfer to unseen audio, and does it let the teacher hand over at Step 2 or 3 with the quality of the released Step-4 handover
theory: for an ideal teacher the endpoint estimate is the posterior mean, which is calibrated, so the fitted correction is the identity; a non-identity fit measures the network's own bias at that step where the answer is known

algorithm.probe: 94 frames ending at the prompt's last frame whose band-averaged log-mel exceeds the prompt's median frame; masked in the teacher's conditioning only (zeros, like the target region); text and canvas length unchanged; at least 0.33 of the prompt stays visible
algorithm.A: per mel band y = a x + c over the probe frames, slope shrunk to (Sxy + 1.0 Sxx) / ((1 + 1.0) Sxx)
algorithm.B: per band the voice-part offset (band average over the probe frames) and one gain on the 9-frame slow part (sh.decompose)
algorithm.handover: the corrected estimate on the target frames, the teacher's estimate elsewhere; the student keeps the full prompt and runs unchanged (released student loop at j = 1)
algorithm.teacher: the released guided Euler teacher on the 16-interval grid with the probe masked

data: the first 40 EXP-012 Quick-set development speakers, clean prompts, synthesis seed = input seed; stored released handovers at Steps 2, 3, 4 and 8 (EXP-018) for the same cases and seeds
smoke: 2 cases (Quick-set positions 59-60): this runner's teacher loop matches the released teacher (max abs <= 0.0001), the hidden conditioning differs only inside the probe, and the stored W3 and W4 scores are reproduced (tolerance 0.01)

criteria.G1_transfer: per variant: median over cases of (corrected / plain error) on the second half of the probe when the correction is fitted on the first half, at Step 3, <= 0.9
criteria.G2_quality: per variant and Step k in [2, 3]: the corrected handover against the released Step-4 handover of the same case and seed: capped-WER difference upper 95% bound <= +0.01, similarity lower bound >= -0.01, UTMOS lower bound >= -0.1; and its UTMOS minus the plain hidden-probe handover at the same step, mean > 0 (the correction is what helps)

decision_rule: build a pilot (pitch variety, noisy prompts, an adaptive handover from the probe error) only if some variant meets G1 and G2 at some step; carry the earliest step, ties broken by the larger UTMOS gain over plain; otherwise report a negative diagnostic with no retuning on these data
power: with 40 speakers the clean Step-4 bounds pass a change as small as refining the teacher's grid in 100% of 300 subsets (EXP-024's power check, code/analysis/exp024_power_check.py)
descriptive: the corrected estimate's distance to the teacher's Step-8 estimate
every output against the released handover at the same step and against the reference; Definition 3.1 failures
novelty: searches on 2026-11-14 (papers and practitioner tools) found no method that hides part of the conditioning to create a known-answer probe of the generator at inference and uses it to correct the handed-over estimate. Closest: CoPaint (known region as a sampling constraint), TD-Paint (known-region error as a diagnostic), Vox-Evaluator (masks generated speech), VoiceStar (masks prompts in training), NoiseShift and cache calibration (corrections fitted offline). Not a full review.
evidence_status: development diagnostic on speakers that designed earlier experiments; not evidence for a claim
adoption: not adopted; changing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only; Shonget-DMOSpeech2 at the pinned commit
